draft.title: Clarifying llama.cpp HTTP server file upload: How does it combine file content with prompts?
draft.body: A Reddit post from 2025 raises questions about how llama.cpp's HTTP server file upload feature integrates uploaded file content with user prompts. The original poster wonders if the file content is simply concatenated with the prompt text before being sent to the model. They used llama 3.2 3B Q4_K_S and tried asking questions about the uploaded file's contents. However, the responses were inconsistent—sometimes the model answered the question correctly, other times it seemed to interpret the file content itself rather than the query. This variability and the lack of clear documentation make it unclear how the file upload feature actually works under the hood. Has anyone here observed or figured out the exact mechanism by which the file upload and prompt are combined? Also, are there known strategies to improve reproducibility of answers when querying uploaded file contents through this interface? Understanding this would help in reliably leveraging the file upload button for local LLM use cases.
